data.comment: Implementation (core repo): replaced per-card-count horizontal layout with a capacity-driven row template in HandView. When maxSlots is set, _computeRowPositions() derives the fixed maxSlots row (the same row the empty hand renders) and places the first N cards into it; _computeOutlineSlots() reuses that template, and _rowArcSpan() keeps per-slot rotation capacity-stable. setMaxSlots() now re-lays the whole row (the only mutation that may move cards). Hands without maxSlots keep the legacy centred-on-count layout; over-capacity is best-effort (first maxSlots slots fixed, outlines capped, overflow continues with the same step). Tests: tests/ui/handView.outlines.test.ts (+11 stability/regression tests, 42 total) and tests/handView/gym-handpile-outlines.browser.test.ts (stability across an add). Docs: docs/DEVELOPER.md, AGENTS.md, GymHandPileScene help text; refreshed docs/dev/context-budget.thresholds.json (+352 project_agents). Build + full unit suite green. Cross-repo AC 7 (Main Street browser test) split out to discovered-from CG-0MUMAZTAY00515MC (main-street repo submodule bump + stability assertions). Assumption confirmed for review: a partially-filled capacity hand is left-anchored in the fixed row (a 1-card hand sits in the leftmost slot), per the approved design.
